title: docs(forensics): declare IBG/AGE precursor lineage documentation patch
intent: Declare the docs-only forensics patch that adds six IBG/AGE precursor lineage investigation documents under docs/forensics and ensures CBSP21 manifest coverage for this PR.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds six new docs/forensics markdown artifacts that reconstruct IBG/AGE precursor chronology, code lineage, semantic drift, sprint rulings, architecture reconstruction, and relationship mapping. Adds this per-PR CBSP21 manifest to declare and scope the docs-only change set.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: These forensics documents did not exist in the repository and establish a new auditable record for precursor lineage and terminology correction. The manifest addition is required so CBSP21 can map this PR's changed files to an applicable declared patch.
